parsed.post: My attempt to increase the learning rate caused a significant regression (1.170127). Reverting to my previous best (1.086585) where the batch size was reduced. I will now try a more cautious approach: slightly reducing the learning rate from 0.1 to 0.05 to find a better stability-speed balance.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate to 0.05 to stabilize training after the previous high LR caused divergence.
